$comment: Machine-readable live-certification expectations shared by the Python and
TypeScript generators. Both test suites read this file, so neither
implementation can drift away from the evidence without a visible failure.
Every entry records where the rule came from. 'live' means an engine
executed it during the certification run; 'live-negative' means an engine
rejected it with the recorded error number; 'static' means the rule is
asserted from documentation only and has not been executed.
No endpoint, database, user name, IP address or path from the
certification environment appears here. Storage hosts that do appear are

engines_certified.note: One host certifies only the version it runs. 2019, 2022, Managed Instance and Fabric SQL remain static-only.
Azure SQL Database has no local-file access; every file cell reaches storage.

rules.statement: A caller-supplied schema, table, external table, file format and credential name must propagate to every generated statement.
rules.why: dbo.orders exists in any TPC-H database. A file called orders.csv must never resolve onto it.

rules.statement: Both CODEPAGE = '1200' and DATAFILETYPE = 'widechar' preserved UTF-16 fidelity on a one-column load (122 rows, banner text intact), with byte and character terminators.
rules.why: The pre-run hypothesis said CODEPAGE 1200 fails. Live evidence disproved it, so the generator must not be changed on the strength of the static claim alone.

rules.statement: A whole-file UTF-16 read needs SINGLE_NCLOB. SINGLE_CLOB on the same path failed with error 4806; SINGLE_NCLOB returned 30420 bytes of the expected text.
CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT accepts only UTF8 and UTF16 as ENCODING.
rules.why: Emitting the detected codepage name produced an invalid keyword.

rules.statement: OPENROWSET with SINGLE_CLOB and DATA_SOURCE against a TYPE = BLOB_STORAGE source succeeded on both engines against https://azcliprod.blob.core.windows.net/cli/vm/aliases.json (relative path vm/aliases.json). ISJSON = 1, JSON_VALUE contentVersion = 1.0.0.0, nested JSON_QUERY bytes = 5280. Azure SQL 228 ms, SQL Server 2025 329 ms.

expect.disproven_claim: SINGLE_CLOB cannot be combined with DATA_SOURCE

rules.statement: NDJSON row framing (FORMAT = 'CSV' with FIELDTERMINATOR / FIELDQUOTE / ROWTERMINATOR) was rejected on an https TYPE = BLOB_STORAGE source with error 5369 on both engines, and succeeded on an abs:// virtualization source: 729 rows, 729 valid JSON documents, longest message 3862 characters.
rules.why: The generator must pick the source by JSON shape: a whole document gets the _Bulk BLOB_STORAGE source and SINGLE_CLOB, NDJSON gets a virtualization source and CSV row framing.

rules.statement: Excel and Iceberg have no external file format. They must emit explicit guidance, never a DELIMITEDTEXT fallthrough.
USE_TYPE_DEFAULT must default to FALSE and always be stated explicitly.
rules.why: TRUE silently rewrites NULL as 0 or an empty string, destroying null fidelity.

rules.statement: CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL WITH IDENTITY = 'MANAGED IDENTITY' succeeded; the database master key count was 0 before, during and after, and cleanup left zero residue.
rules.caveat: Blob RBAC itself was never exercised: no user storage account was authorised for the run.

rules.statement: FIRST_ROW in CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT is accepted on the engines certified here.
rules.why: azure_sql_mi is excluded deliberately: no engine in this run certified it, and claiming it would be an overclaim.

rules.statement: CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT WITH (FORMAT_TYPE = DELTA) was accepted and dropped with zero residue on both engines. This certifies the DDL only; querying protocol 1/2 data awaits a staged fixture.
FORMAT_TYPE = ORC was accepted and dropped with zero residue on both engines, but no maintained public ORC blob was available, so the data path is unverified.
RCFILE was rejected with error 46506 (invalid FORMAT_TYPE options) and a JSON format type with error 102 (syntax error near JSON) on both engines.
Changing a staged path from yellow/ to Yellow/ produced error 13807 (directory cannot be listed) on both engines.

Boundary values round-tripped on both engines: signed and unsigned integer extremes including uint64 18446744073709551615 in DECIMAL(20,0), DECIMAL(18,4), REAL, FLOAT, BIT, Japanese NVARCHAR codepoints, VARBINARY hex, and date/time/datetime2 precision. DATETIMEOFFSET preserved +09:00 under CONVERT style 121 with DATEPART(TZOFFSET) = 540.
rules.why: CONVERT style 127 normalises datetimeoffset to UTC with a Z suffix on both engines, so asserting +09 against style 127 is a harness error, not a mapping defect.

rules.statement: JSON_MODIFY round-tripped Unicode exactly, JSON_ARRAY returned the exact Japanese value, and a nested OPENJSON ... WITH returned 2 typed rows on both engines.
A complete script that still contains an unresolved <placeholder> must not describe itself as ready to run as-is.
Certification claims may name only the engines that actually executed the cells.
